annual_periods: frozen selection-year cohort realized net P/L from source-strategy-annual.csv; cohorts may overlap and must not be summed
average_profit_loss: mean positive / mean negative completed-trade net P/L
five_periods_positive: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026-09 YTD realized net P/L are each > 0
maximum_consecutive_losses: longest run of completed trades with net_pnl < 0, ordered by exit_date
maximum_drawdown: peak-to-subsequent-trough drawdown of cumulative realized completed-trade net P/L ordered by exit_date; not a TWD 500,000 account-equity drawdown
maximum_single_trade_profit_loss: max/min costed net_pnl among completed trades
pooled_totals_and_risk: one copy per canonical economic trade key
profit_factor: sum positive completed-trade net P/L / absolute sum negative completed-trade net P/L
ranking: profitable periods desc, net per 100 bought desc, total realized net P/L desc, realized trade P/L curve max drawdown asc, completed trades desc
win_rate: completed trades with net_pnl > 0 / all completed trades
